DROID: Distributed Robot Interaction Dataset
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

DROID (Distributed Robot Interaction Dataset) is a large-scale "in-the-wild" robot manipulation dataset containing 76K teleoperated demonstration trajectories — approximately 350 hours of interaction data — collected across 564 unique scenes, 86 tasks, and 52 buildings over the course of 12 months.
